## The fallback emission (ladder rung ii — pre-authorized)

| file | generated by | role |
|---|---|---|
| snnTorch_linear_head.nir | tools/gen_snnTorch_stranger.py — snnTorch's own extractor (`_extract_snntorch_module` + nirtorch), the CURRENT stranger stack from PyPI: snntorch 1.0.0 · torch 2.13.0+cpu · nirtorch 2.6 · nir 1.0.8 | FULL PATH — Linear-only (Input[64] → Linear 32×64 float32 → Output): no LIF ⇒ no r-convention; the weights are OUR seeded values (torch.manual_seed(7883)) through THEIR pipeline — the pre-authorized class, stated openly |

**Why the fallback fired (the corpus-v2 finding of record):** every
third-party LIF emission in the paper corpus carries the
simulation-unit convention — r = 1.0 Ω (two_lif, norse), 24.02 Ω
(rockpool) — below the substrate's biological quantization floor
(r ≥ 1 MΩ, snn nir.rs quantize_lif). snnTorch itself cannot do
otherwise: its LIF is dimensionless (β/threshold, no R), so its NIR
exports hard-code r = 1.0. The wall is the CONVENTION BOUNDARY
itself, not any one emitter — recorded for the principal (it bears on
GUARD 3's "stranger-usable" wording).
